label: United states flag layout context
adaptation_note: Thirteen-stripe/canton overview, fifty-centre position map and eighteen row-part details. Fifty full star glyphs are retained across the sequence; no stripe-only frame is called the complete flag.
acceptance_requirement: Account for all fifty stars in their alternating rows and all thirteen stripes; mark the overview as incomplete without its detail sequence.

frames.title: Thirteen stripes and canton
frames.teaching_key: United States layout overview: thirteen alternating red/white stripes, red at top and bottom; the blue canton occupies the upper hoist and covers the hoist portions of the upper seven stripes. This overview deliberately omits the fifty white stars, supplied by the canton-position frame and row details. Outline proportions are quantized, not textile specifications.

frames.title: Fifty canton-star positions
frames.teaching_key: The enlarged canton-only position map uses one pin per star centre, in nine alternating rows of six and five. This preserves the source row arrangement at grid resolution, not star form. Subsequent frames supply enlarged five-point glyphs; navigate by row and column key.

checks.position_encoding: one pin per centre; glyph form supplied separately

frames.title: Canton row 1, columns 1–3
